nodes.label: Mandatory 8-step Workflow
nodes.rationale: Explicit user approval required whenever a rule demands a pause; silence is never approval.

nodes.label: IBM Carbon and Fluent 2 Anchors
nodes.rationale: Carbon for data-tool density (48px rows, 4px grid); Fluent 2 for Windows desktop affordances.

nodes.label: IBM Plex Sans Typography Scale
nodes.rationale: No rendered text below 12px; 600/400 weight pair keeps product-app calm.

nodes.label: Space, Radius, Elevation and Motion Tokens
nodes.norm_label: space, radius, elevation and motion tokens

nodes.label: Approved Decisions D1-D6 (21/10/2026)
nodes.rationale: D1 redesign approved as explicit exception to projeto.md 14/17; banner text and slogan kept; IBM Plex Sans; tests infra; split index.css; 1280x800 window and WebP banner.

nodes.label: Implementation Batches L0-L8
nodes.rationale: Exclusive file ownership per batch allows parallel agents L3-L7 without edit conflicts.

nodes.label: Visual Direction 'Institucional Operacional'
nodes.rationale: Analysts doing risky repetitive tasks need legibility, predictability and error prevention over visual impact.

nodes.label: Rule Conflicts C1-C5
nodes.rationale: Project rules (CLAUDE.md/projeto.md) prevail over ECC design rules; code is source of truth.

nodes.label: DataHub SEDUC-MT Desktop App
nodes.rationale: Centralize spreadsheet/data routines without users running Python scripts manually; principles: simplicity, low cognitive load, error prevention.

nodes.label: Mocks and Pending Persistence
nodes.rationale: Never present mock as real functionality; migrate gradually.

nodes.label: DESIGN.md Visual Spec (DataHub SEDUC-MT)
nodes.rationale: Single source of visual decisions; new screens reuse tokens, no parallel palette.

nodes.label: Rule: Ask Before Refactoring
nodes.rationale: Identifying a refactoring opportunity does not mean having permission to implement it; keeps scope under user control.

nodes.label: Rule: Domain Isolation
nodes.rationale: A change in one domain must not unintentionally break another; every change is evaluated for what depends on it.

nodes.label: Rule: Suggest the Best Approach
nodes.rationale: Recommend the best engineering approach but let the developer decide on design/business decisions; apply purely syntactic improvements autonomously.
